issues.summary: Zero-voltage accumulation clamps to the 0.5 V phase-2 result despite a directly available zero-voltage primary event.
The analysis substitutes inductor current for switch current after the freewheel branch conducts; the source also describes a switch-off event that its conductance law does not implement.
The trace has a negative inductor-current tail. This does not prove reverse diode conduction, and inductor current alone cannot prove zero reverse diode current.
Table S2 p.38 is overall circuit efficiency at three output voltages, not a 77.3-90.9% primary-stage efficiency table. SI p.36 distinguishes LTC3588-2 and a downstream LTC3588-1 for low output rails.
Source-driven harvesting, cold start and regulated-load operation remain unsupported. MCU is not applicable.
